appointments_cancellation_check.name: appointments_cancellation_check
appointments_cancellation_check.value: ("appointments"."status" = 'cancelled') = ("appointments"."cancelled_at" is not null and "appointments"."cancelled_by" is not null)

generated.as: CASE WHEN 'anamnesis' = ANY(modules) THEN anamnesis_template_choice END

clinics_display_name_check.name: clinics_display_name_check
clinics_display_name_check.value: "clinics"."display_name" is null or char_length("clinics"."display_name") between 1 and 40

clinics_area_label_check.name: clinics_area_label_check
clinics_area_label_check.value: "clinics"."area_label" is null or char_length("clinics"."area_label") between 1 and 40

patients_identity_check.name: patients_identity_check
patients_identity_check.value: "patients"."anonymized_at" is not null or ("patients"."phone" is not null and "patients"."name_normalized" is not null)

patients_anonymized_check.name: patients_anonymized_check
patients_anonymized_check.value: "patients"."anonymized_at" is null or ("patients"."phone" is null and "patients"."email" is null and "patients"."name_normalized" is null and "patients"."nickname" is null and "patients"."cpf" is null and "patients"."rg" is null and "patients"."landline_phone" is null and "patients"."birth_date" is null and "patients"."gender" is null and "patients"."referral_source" is null and "patients"."referred_by" is null and "patients"."notes" is null and "patients"."user_id" is null)

patients_lengths_check.name: patients_lengths_check
patients_lengths_check.value: char_length("patients"."nickname") <= 40 and char_length("patients"."rg") <= 20 and char_length("patients"."referred_by") <= 120 and char_length("patients"."notes") <= 1000

installments_appointment_check.name: installments_appointment_check
installments_appointment_check.value: "installments"."appointment_id" is null or "installments"."sale_item_id" is not null

receipts_appointment_active_idx.name: receipts_appointment_active_idx
receipts_appointment_active_idx.where: "receipts"."appointment_id" is not null and "receipts"."reversed_at" is null

stock_movements_quantity_check.name: stock_movements_quantity_check
stock_movements_quantity_check.value:
("stock_movements"."kind" = 'entry' and "stock_movements"."quantity" > 0)
        or ("stock_movements"."kind" in ('usage', 'handover') and "stock_movements"."quantity" < 0)
        or ("stock_movements"."kind" = 'reversal' and "stock_movements"."quantity" <> 0)

stock_movements_links_check.name: stock_movements_links_check
stock_movements_links_check.value:
("stock_movements"."kind" = 'usage' and "stock_movements"."appointment_id" is not null)
        or ("stock_movements"."kind" = 'handover' and "stock_movements"."sale_item_id" is not null and "stock_movements"."appointment_id" is null)
        or ("stock_movements"."kind" = 'entry' and "stock_movements"."appointment_id" is null and "stock_movements"."sale_item_id" is null)
        or "stock_movements"."kind" = 'reversal'
